Message:
Bluetooth: Fix returning proper mgmt status for Load LTKs

Failures of mgmt commands should be indicated with valid mgmt status
codes, and EINVAL is not one of them. Instead MGMT_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMS
should be returned.
